_comment: Z-Image Turbo text-to-image, in ComfyUI API format. Derived from the official 'image_z_image_turbo' workflow template shipped with ComfyUI 0.35.0 (/templates/image_z_image_turbo.json), flattened out of its subgraph. Key non-obvious bits: the Qwen3 text encoder loads as CLIPLoader type='lumina2', and the model needs ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift=3. Steps=8, cfg=1, sampler=res_multistep, scheduler=simple. Replace __PROMPT__ (or pass --set). The official template uses qwen_3_4b.safetensors; this install has the fp8_mixed variant, hence the clip_name below.
